#!/bin/sh
set -eu
systemctl --user show ji-host.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecMainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp
pid=$(systemctl --user show ji-host.service -p ExecMainPID --value)
tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline"
printf '\nCURRENT='
readlink "$HOME/.local/share/ji-host/current"
printf 'LOCATOR='
tr '\n' ',' < "$HOME/.local/share/ji-host/run/host-locator"
printf '\n'
rest=$(sed -n 's/^rest=//p' "$HOME/.local/share/ji-host/run/host-locator")
"$HOME/.local/share/ji-host/current/bin/ji-host" --health-check "http://127.0.0.1:$rest/api/v1/health/ready"
printf '%s\n' STAGE6_REMOTE_HOST_READY
